comment: Narrowed, not replicated. Five in-domain runs at triangle side 5.0, at rest, T=1.5, tracker only: 017 (A, B, C), 018 and 019 (cyclic ABC permutations), 020 and 021 (A, A, A). Errors against this paper's model.py: 0.00466, 0.00495, 0.00510, 0.00521, 0.00493; bar 3 x 0.07 = 0.21. Residual rms per coordinate 0.047-0.052; no census events. The model is consistent with the data at side 5.0. It is not consistent with the stated domains: model.py raises for any separation outside 5.0 +/- 0.05, so it cannot score the edges claimed (c1 side 4.5-5.5, c2 side 3.75-5.0). I did not test those edges against the paper's model, so I do not replicate them. The proposed domain covers the five runs: species A, B, C, separation 4.95-5.05, up to three particles. I am not citing my side-4.5 or side-3.75 runs from 2026-11-19 as evidence because the model cannot predict them.
